svg.title: Amazon S3 security and service overview
svg.desc: Bucket policies and legacy ACLs control access. Encryption protects data at rest and HTTPS with TLS protects API traffic. New buckets disable ACLs by default. Versioning, Lifecycle rules, common uses, integrations, and costs complete the overview.
svg.text: • Data management: versioning and Lifecycle rules
• Common uses: backups, static website content, and large datasets
• Integrations: works with other AWS services
• Cost drivers: storage, requests, retrievals, and data transfer
Website endpoints are HTTP-only; use CloudFront or Amplify Hosting for HTTPS.
